summary: Digi Power X Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) to increase the maximum amount of subordinate voting shares sold via an at-the-market offering from A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners from the prior limit to a total of $175,000,000. As of filing, $72,363,650 of the originally registered $75,000,000 had been sold. The shares trade on Nasdaq (DGXX) and Cboe Canada (DGX); last sale on May 7, 2026 was $6.19 per share. A.G.P. receives a 3.0% commission. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
